content:
Close the 3 editor-build blockers + ship the verified editor (#83). (1) check.rs: add fn_is_diverge + diverge_l1_cert + GateOutcome::DivergeL1; gate_fn routes a non-boundary/non-slag fx-diverge fn to an L1 partial-correctness cap that continues like BoundaryL1/SlagL1 (no verus, no §7 mutation/strengthen) — honest + diverge-only. (2) l1.rs blocker 2: lower_fn_l1 snapshots non-Copy params an ens references into

__pre clones before the body, rewrites ens via rename_params_in_expr; TString/struct/enum derive Clone. (3) l1.rs blocker 3: Expr::StrLit (exec) materializes a TString (Vec byte-push, mirroring lower.rs #82). Tests: forge/tests/editor_runs.rs (edit core L3, run L1, build+run with piped keys, diverge-only regressions). README. Gauntlet: workspace test/clippy/fmt.
